messages:
Luis (Sales): Client wants a quick 4-day POC to prove migration from CompetitorX. Key asks: drop-in API compatibility, prompt parity for their 100 prompt set, and a cost/run-rate comparison. Can eng + solutions scope?
Nina (Solutions): Yes. Plan: 1) adapter exposing CompetitorX endpoints 2) run golden corpus (100 prompts) 3) produce diff + token mapping 4) cost projection. Need their sample payloads and model IDs.
Client-CTO: We'll upload anonymized traffic and 25 must-match prompts. No persisted user prompts allowed. Also need SSO and on-prem options.
Marco (SE): We'll provide a compat param that maps response fields and enforces deterministic decode for parity tests. Streaming differences are common — we'll force non-streaming during the POC.
Asha (Eng): On tokenizer differences: we'll record token counts and produce a mapping table. Small formatting diffs (lists, punctuation) handled by the adapter normalizer.
Luis (Sales): They want a demo Thu. Can we have the SOW + risk list by EOD?
Tina (Legal): Share SIG questionnaire. For on-prem, we support KMS + air-gapped install; need network egress matrix from client.
deploy-bot: Sandbox created: competitorx-poc-1785. Creds DM'd to Nina.
Nina (Solutions): Received. Client-CTO: upload prompts.csv and traces to the sandbox.
Client-CTO: Uploaded prompts.csv (25) and traffic.json.
Marco (SE): Running compare now. Quick curl template for adapter test: curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.internal/adapter -H 'Authorization: Bearer $T' -d '{"endpoint":"/generate","body":{"prompt":"..."},"compat":"compx-v1"}'
Asha (Eng): Early results: 25 must-match -> 23 intent matches, 2 JSON structure mismatches. Token delta avg +2 tokens. Latency looks fine.
Nina (Solutions): Success criteria suggestion: >=92% intent match for must-match prompts, structural shim for mismatches, <=10% cost uplift.
Luis (Sales): Also plan fallback: route 10% traffic to current provider for first 72hrs.
Client-CTO: Acceptable. Provide run-rate calc with token mapping assumptions.
Marco (SE): I'll upload diff artifacts to sandbox:/artifacts/1785 and attach runbook for SRE handoff.
Nina (Solutions): Action items: SOW draft, risk register (drift, token mismatch, streaming, latency, billing), run-rate spreadsheet, adapter code. Aim to share before demo Thu.
Luis (Sales): Thanks team — keeping thread open for artifacts and final SOW.
